opening.argument: The video’s primary purpose is to explain how Binance’s Recurring Buy feature schedules cryptocurrency purchases under a dollar-cost-averaging approach. The description expressly presents it as instruction on “an automated crypto purchasing tool,” and the narration explains that users do not need to monitor or repeatedly open Binance. It also describes an operational payment step: “you can click in the BTC with a card and pay with a card, or whatever.” The referral code, bonus and cashback wording, together with the weekly Bitcoin purchase setup, are promotional text and app configuration visible alongside the tool, not evidence of a deceptive outcome or guaranteed return. The displayed 500.000 IDR recurring-buy amount and “Buy BTC” control reinforce that the material demonstrates setup. Any reference to more profit is a qualified example connected to recurring purchases, not a promised result.
